title: About Me
paragraphs: I am a Python developer with commercial backend experience. I have been working at Mailganer — an email marketing platform — since May 2025: I grew from intern to Junior Developer, and am now stepping into the role of lead developer on an internal AI project built on RAG.

My core stack: Python, Django, PostgreSQL, JavaScript. I work on feature development, security auditing, complex bug investigations, and performance optimization. I am comfortable reading and improving existing codebases and finding root causes where the symptoms are not obvious.

Before programming, I spent 11 years as a university lecturer and worked as a meteorological engineer. This background gives me a strong sense for data, the ability to explain complex things clearly, and precision in problem formulation — things that years in an IDE alone cannot replace.
Outside of work, I enjoy fitness, mountain hiking, cycling, and motorsports.
I am open to new challenges and ready to collaborate.
